Metadata.CommitMsg:
fix: Windows CI tests use PowerShell 5.1 and GITHUB_WORKSPACE

Pester 5 on pwsh left PSScriptRoot empty so all path checks failed. Use built-in Pester 3 on windows-latest and resolve repo root via GITHUB_WORKSPACE.
